actions.visibleState: A centered Memory Journey introduction names the three-part journey, lists WASD/arrows, E/click, Space, and Shift, and offers Enter the world. Step 1 already says Meet the Listener Guide.
actions.interpretation: The blue Enter the world button is the intended first action and the Guide is the first objective.
actions.result: The modal closed and the world, Guide marker, pulsing trail, demo button, and controls became visible.

actions.visibleState: The left panel says Choose a song to begin and presents Start the Crywolf demo prominently.
actions.interpretation: The built-in demo is the approved way to begin without choosing a file.
actions.result: ATHETOSIS — Crywolf.ogg loaded in Ready state and exposed a Play button.

actions.visibleState: The loaded track is Ready at 0 / 278s and the Guide remains visibly marked ahead.
actions.interpretation: Music must be playing for the journey to respond.
actions.result: Status changed to Playing, lighting changed, captions appeared, and time advanced.

actions.visibleState: The player appears aligned with a bright trail and the Listener Guide marker directly ahead; the objective says Speak with the Guide.
actions.interpretation: The listed E interaction should speak with the nearby Guide.
actions.result: The objective and visible world state did not advance.

actions.visibleState: The Guide marker is still prominent and step 1 is unchanged.
actions.interpretation: Clicking the visible destination may be the alternative interaction listed by the introduction.
actions.result: A yellow Not Yet message said the Archive is sealed and to speak with the Listener Guide first; step 1 remained unchanged.

actions.visibleState: The trail still connects the player area to the Guide and no explicit in-range interaction prompt appears.
actions.interpretation: The Guide may require a closer interaction range.
actions.result: There was no visible objective transition; step 1 remained Meet the Listener Guide.

actions.visibleState: The Guide, trail, and step-1 card remain visible; the music continues normally.
actions.interpretation: World focus may be required because the Play control previously held visible focus.
actions.input: Clicked open ground, held W, and retried interaction/clicking around the marked Guide.
actions.result: The journey did not advance. One click opened the Echo Terminal help overlay, whose Current Objective still said Speak with the Listener Guide.

actions.visibleState: The Echo Terminal repeats the same objective and lists E or click an object, but supplies no range or recovery cue.
actions.interpretation: The same blocker has repeated three times, so independent completion is no longer credible within the run contract.
actions.input: Closed the overlay and used the visible timeline to inspect the natural ending.
actions.result: At 278 / 278s the caption said Only the afterglow remains, while Journey step 1 / 3 still said Meet the Listener Guide.

actions.visibleState: At natural ending the transport showed Play at 278 / 278s and no distinct Replay label.
actions.interpretation: Play is the only visible restart affordance and should replay from the beginning.
actions.result: The transport returned to Playing at 2 / 278s and the opening world state/caption reappeared; step 1 was reset/preserved as the first objective.

findings.statement: The first journey objective did not advance after three ordinary attempts using the displayed controls and visible Guide route; the run could not proceed beyond step 1.

Clicking the visually marked objective area produced contradictory destinations: an Archive-sealed warning and later the Echo Terminal, while both told the listener to speak with the Guide and offered no recovery cue.
Natural ending left the incomplete step-1 objective active and did not explain whether the journey could still be completed after the music stopped.

The entry/Guide presentation is visibly clearer than an unprompted world entry because it names controls, gives one primary Enter action, and immediately marks the Guide, but the operational Guide blocker is not resolved because the displayed interaction path still fails to advance the first objective.

Make the Guide interaction succeed from the clearly presented starting route and provide an unmistakable in-range prompt plus visible acknowledgement that advances step 1; ensure clicks on the Guide marker cannot resolve to the Archive or help overlay.
Replay is discoverable only through the generic Play label at the ended position; using it visibly restarts playback from the opening state.
